result.instructions: Tools for Equicty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our horses are public on the website, and how old are they?"; "Show me the pedigree and profile details of one public horse."; "List all public stallions in our stable.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Equicty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run equicty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run equicty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run equicty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. equicty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: equicty_list_public_horses
tools.title: List public horses
tools.description: List the horses the stable marked public for its website: name, age, birthday, sex, studbook, colour, height, 3-generation pedigree, and profile and miniature image URLs. Only public horses are returned; private horses are not reachable through this API. Equicty Website API: POST /horses.

language.description: Language of the horse data (default EN).

tools.name: equicty_get_public_horse
tools.title: Get a public horse
tools.description: Get one public horse by id, including its pedigree, profile and miniature image URLs, and the videos and pictures the stable made public. Only public horses are reachable. Equicty Website API: GET /horses/{id}.

language.description: Language of the horse data (default EN).
